info.name: nickProtection
info.description: Prevents stealing of protected nicknames as well as nickchange spam.
info.author: driver2

setting.name: *changeNickInsteadOfKicking
setting.desc: Change nick of players who fail to authenticate in time.

setting.name: *timeForLogin
setting.desc: Number of seconds that players have to login to their account if they use a protected nick.

setting.name: *useTextDisplays
setting.friendlyname: Use Text Displays to warn players
setting.desc: Use Text Displays together with the message in the chat to warn players.

setting.name: *protectedNicksPerAccount
setting.desc: Maximum number of protected nicks allowed per account.

setting.name: *protectedNicksPerAccountExtended
setting.desc: Maximum number of protected nicks allowed per account for users who have the resource.nickProtection.extended right in their ACL.

setting.name: *protectedNicksExpireAfterDays
setting.friendlyname: Nicks expire after these many days
setting.desc: Protected nicks expire (get deleted) if they haven't been used these many days.

setting.name: *protectedNicksExpireMode
setting.desc: Nicks can expire after some time, this determines how that happens: 0 - Nicks don't expire at all, 1 - Regular nicks expire (but not those for users that have the resource.nickProtection.extended right), 2 - All nicks expire

setting.name: *enableNickChangeSpamProtection
setting.desc: Enables protection against people changing their nicks too often.

setting.name: *nickChangeSpamProtectionWaitTime
setting.desc: Wait for this many seconds before player is allowed to change nick again.

setting.name: *maxNickChanges
setting.desc: Maximum number of nick changes before the player has to wait.
